name: linkedin-mcp
description: Unofficial MCP server for LinkedIn — exposes the in-browser Voyager API as a set of tools, so any MCP client (Claude Code, Cursor, Claude Desktop) can run profile lookups, connections, DMs, posts, and comments through your own logged-in Chrome session. No third-party API keys, no per-seat fees, undetectable because requests come from real Chrome with your real cookies. Not affiliated with LinkedIn or Microsoft.
